title: English Sentence Foundations
focus: Construir sentenças completas com sujeito, verbo e complemento
verifiableTask: Construir oito sentenças corretas sobre vida acadêmica

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
falar e escrever 8 frases corretas sobre a vida na universidade, sem esquecer o sujeito nem o verbo.
construir oito sentenças corretas sobre vida acadêmica.
Responda com frases completas (sujeito + verbo + complemento):
What do you study (or what do you do)?
What time do your classes or your work start?
Is it easy or difficult to study after work?
diga em uma frase sua maior prioridade para o TOEFL.
I'm taking four courses this semester.
The assignment is due on Monday.
I attend three lectures a week.
O professor lê; o aluno repete e depois diz em qual grupo cada palavra entra.
Ouça, compare e repita (com e sem -s):
She studies at night, watches lectures online, and submits her assignments on time.

questions.questionText: “The essay is ______ tomorrow.” (o prazo é amanhã)

explanations.B: Due = com prazo para. The essay is due tomorrow.
explanations.general: Correct answer: due
Correct answer: Your main area of study

questions.questionText: Which word ends with an extra syllable /ɪz/?

explanations.general: Correct answer: watches

questions.questionText: Choose the best word: “My ______ is very busy this week.”

explanations.general: Correct answer: schedule

content.text: A frase em inglês sempre tem sujeito e verbo
Em português podemos dizer “Estudo à noite” ou “É importante”. Em inglês
She works. He studies. It starts.
Leia junto com o professor e depois fale junto (mesmo ritmo).

My name is Julia. I study biology at a public university. I have lectures every morning. The first lecture starts at eight. My favorite course is genetics because the professor explains everything clearly. In the afternoon, I go to the library with my classmates. We do our assignments together. It is a busy schedule, but I like it.
What time does the first lecture start?
Why is genetics her favorite course?
What does she do in the afternoon?
→ She → My classmates → He → We → Julia
→ at nine thirty → in the afternoon → on Monday → after lunch
→ necessary → difficult → easy → a good idea
4.2 Conserte a frase (fale a versão correta)
Is very cold in the classroom.
Have a lot of books in the library.
Study every night for the test.
Is difficult to understand fast speech.
Are many students in my course.
assignment / due / is / the / Friday / on
classmates / my / in / study / library / the
there / students / are / thirty / my / in / class

options.text: Is very cold in the classroom.
It is very cold in the classroom.
Very cold is in the classroom.

explanations.general: Correct answer: It is very cold in the classroom.

options.text: Have a lot of books in the library.
There are a lot of books in the library.
It has a lot of books in the library.

explanations.A: Falta sujeito e a estrutura correta é There are.
explanations.C: Em inglês usamos “there are” para existência.
explanations.general: Correct answer: There are a lot of books in the library.
My professor explains very well.
She doesn't live on campus.
The class starts at nine.

questions.questionText: ______ is difficult to understand fast speech. (sujeito)

explanations.general: It is difficult to understand fast speech.

questions.questionText: Put in order: assignment / due / is / the / Friday / on

options.text: The assignment is due on Friday.
The assignment due is on Friday.
Is the assignment due on Friday.

explanations.C: Isso é pergunta e precisaria de “?”.
explanations.general: Correct answer: The assignment is due on Friday.

questions.questionText: In the model text, Julia does her assignments alone.

explanations.general: Falso: “We do our assignments together.”
